selected_script.angle: After meal prep, wiping a greasy marinade splash on the countertop with just water leaves a slick film where bacteria worries start; Liapu enters as the quick spray-and-wipe solution for countertop, highchair tray, and trash-can lid touch zones with a lemon-fresh no-residue finish.
selected_script.hook: That wet paper towel is not cleaning this greasy prep mess.

script_record.pain_point: Greasy food prep splatter on kitchen surfaces looks wiped but still feels slick and questionable, especially around family touch zones.
script_record.conflict_hook: A close-up wet paper towel pushes greasy marinade streaks across a white quartz countertop near the sink instead of lifting it clean.
script_record.product_solution: Liapu Kitchen Spray is brought into the same messy counter scene, sprayed directly onto the slick film, then wiped to reveal a clean, lemon-fresh surface with no harsh residue.
script_record.cta: Keep kitchen touch zones cleaner, fast.

timeline.scene: Handheld close-up of a white quartz countertop after meal prep, with orange-brown greasy marinade splatter near the sink. A wet paper towel wipes across it, but the streak spreads into a shiny slick film. Finger lightly taps the surface and shows oily residue. Voiceover: "That wet paper towel is not cleaning this greasy prep mess."

The Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray enters from frame right, white translucent cylindrical plastic bottle with trigger sprayer and yellow front label facing camera. User sprays the greasy countertop area 2-3 times, waits a beat, then wipes with a clean white paper towel. Voiceover: "I spray Liapu on the slick spots, give it a second, and wipe."

Fast-cut result on the same countertop: camera tilts low across the cleaned quartz surface, showing no oily shine and no visible film. Product stays upright in the background with yellow label visible. Voiceover: "The grease actually lifts instead of smearing around."

Different real-life usage environment: highchair tray or highchair exterior tray area after a snack, with small greasy fingerprints and crumbs. Product is visible beside the tray; user sprays lightly onto the surface area and wipes clean. Voiceover: "I use it on the messy spots everyone touches, too."

Final usage scene: kitchen trash-can lid or stainless trash-can top with greasy fingerprints from cooking. Product remains central; user sprays, wipes once, then does a quick touch test with fingertips showing a clean dry finish. Voiceover: "No sticky residue, just a clean lemon-fresh finish."
Product held in hand in front of the cleaned counter, label facing camera, realistic handheld kitchen background. Voiceover: "Keep kitchen touch zones cleaner, fast."

script_record.product_consistency_notes: Keep product as Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser: white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, translucent body showing liquid level, trigger sprayer with nozzle, yellow front-center label reading CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml. Do not change color, shape, material, size ratio, label placement, texture, or visible structure. Do not add accessories, buttons, lights, extra packaging, cords, screens, or decorative elements.
